strong_seat_rule: R27 (PM 2026-10-23): the top --strong-seats Longlist/Elder names not otherwise in the room, by 20-day strength vs SPY, are seated and voted in the MOMENTUM lane.
swing_seat_rule: SWING_PIVOT (PM 2026-11-05): up to --swing-seats names with the export's swing_pivot true (weekly and daily HH/HL, daily close within 1 ATR of the latest daily swing high), not otherwise in the room, by AQE rank. Voted, MOMENTUM lane, ADDITIVE after the floor, the held book, R25 and R27.
unr_seat_rule: R25 (PM 2026-10-23): up to --unr-seats names with AQE unr_status MET on the Longlist or Elder list, not otherwise in the room, by AQE rank. Voted like any name, PULLBACK lane (whole room).
informational_rule: R17 (PM ruling 2026-09-25): a name no seat nominated is FLAGGED FOR THE PM, never seated. It is not voted, gets no verdict, and cannot supersede committee consensus. R26 (2026-10-23): the flag list is every Longlist/Elder name not in the room, ordered by 20-day strength vs SPY > AQE rank.

doors_rule.NOMINATED: R16: nominated by ANY seat at ANY conviction. ADMITTED UNCONDITIONALLY -- never cut, never ordered against a machine find, never subject to the cap.
doors_rule.HELD: R16 + R12: a position the PM owns. On the floor unconditionally, so the ADD question is asked and not only the keep/exit question.
doors_rule.SEATS: nominated by >=2 seats (a NOMINATED name; the count is kept for ordering and for the lane)
doors_rule.SOLO: nominated by 1 seat at conviction >=4 (a NOMINATED name; retained as a label only -- R16 made the second-door requirement moot)
doors_rule.ELDER+LENS: elder>=7 on each of last 2 bars AND >=3/6 lenses strong (FLAG ONLY -- R17: surfaces to the PM, never seats a name)
doors_rule.LENS: >=4/6 lenses strong (FLAG ONLY -- R17: surfaces to the PM, never seats a name)
doors_rule.STRENGTH: rs_spy_20d in top 10% of today's list (>= 38.71) OR mp>=75 AND mp_accel_state ACCELERATING (FLAG ONLY -- R17: surfaces to the PM, never seats a name)
doors_rule.SWING_PIVOT: PM 2026-11-05: export swing_pivot true (weekly AND daily HH/HL, daily close within 1 ATR of the latest daily swing high). SEATED and voted, MOMENTUM lane, up to --swing-seats (default 6) by AQE rank, ADDITIVE after the floor, the held book, R25 and R27.
doors_rule.PM_LENS: >=5 of the PM's 6 checks (FLAG ONLY -- R17: surfaces to the PM, never seats a name)
doors_rule.AQE_LEADER: elder_pattern SUSTAINED|ACCELERATION AND rs_leadership LEADER (FLAG ONLY -- R17: surfaces to the PM, never seats a name; mp_state not consulted -- R13)

lanes_rule.PULLBACK: all other admitted names; verdict from all voting seats

ranking_key: R16 (PM ruling 2026-09-24): the NOMINATION FLOOR is admitted whole and first -- every nomination, any conviction, no cap. It is ordered seat_count > conviction_sum > thematic_support > sc_momentum for reading only; ordering never removes a name. R17 (2026-09-25): the doors seat NOBODY. 0 door-openers are FLAGGED for the PM as information, ordered doors_opened > lenses_strong > AQE rank; they are not voted and carry no verdict. The strength reserve is RETIRED.
